'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Team T.N Are my heroes. DS-72-2 In Obsidian 2 as written (may redlink). Short Range Fighters published as combo with Watch Your Back!.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
